About Liferay Liferay is a uniquely profitable B2B enterprise software company with 1,000+ fiery-eyed employees all across Europe, the Americas, the Middle East, Asia, and Africa. As a renowned provider of enterprise open source technologies, we have been recognized by Gartner for empowering businesses around the world to solve complex digital challenges. Liferay's all-in-one platform unites Liferay DXP with our cloud platform capabilities, built-in analytics, and commerce functionality, reducing time to market and accelerating innovation. Our customer roster includes global companies such as Airbus, US Bank, Honda, and Desjardins. But we don't just make awesome software, we are also fueled by a greater-than-profit vision. By building a vibrant business, making technology useful, and investing in communities, we make it possible for people to reach their full potential to serve others. This commitment extends beyond our product; Liferay donates 10% of our profits to charities around the world. Oh, we're also self-funded which gives us the freedom to work on whatever we think brings the most value to customers and communities in the long run! About You and this Role Liferay is looking for Associate and Medium level experienced Incident Management Specialists to be part of our Engineering team. If you enjoy solving problems and thrive in a customer-centric environment, don't just focus on operations but also love running systems and software in the real world and love being able to build, ship, and run applications with ease, at Liferay you will have the opportunity to experience it all! The ideal candidate for this role has some experience in distributed systems, Linux/Unix design, networking, and systems and reliability engineering. The candidate should also enjoy working on challenging technical problems with short deadlines, is able to be calm under pressure and has excellent English communication skills. If you joy our team you will learn everything about containers, and container orchestration with Kubernetes. One of your passions will become building DevOps tools that make it easier for people to build, deploy and scale apps on our Cloud platform. Key Objectives Monitor Liferay's Cloud Systems and respond to requests within SLA Be on call 25% of the time Respond to monitoring events within the SLAs following documented procedures Respond to security threats within the SLAs following the trained and agreed workflows Be the L1 Support team for security threats, data breaches Manage release process and pipelines Manage support tickets and patches for systems Execute documented changes on our Cloud infrastructure Provide technical support to include troubleshooting user operating problems, application problems, system configuration issues and malfunctions, and network operating problems in a cloud environment. Required Qualifications BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience Experience with Docker and Terraform Experience running and maintaining a 24x7 production environment Experience scripting in some of the common languages used by system engineers (shell, golang) Experience operating large-scale distributed systems preferably using GCP Knowledge of Networking, VPN, identifying and solving network issues Strong English communication and team player skills Preferred Qualifications Experience with at least one of the following managed Kubernetes services: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) Experience in automating development processes and environments. Experience implementing full CI/CD (continuous integration/continuous delivery) pipelines. Experience with Linux, MySQL, NGINX, Tomcat, Git, Jenkins. Any of the following certifications: Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect Google Cloud Certified Professional DevOps Engineer Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Security Engineer Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Network Engineer What We Offer Salary package w/ competitive benefits according to qualifications and experience Opportunities to take responsibility, grow professionally, and Stay Nerdy A positive and collaborative work culture Working at a leading open-source company Equal Opportunities Employer - Statement Liferay is committed to the equal treatment of all candidates, customers and employees and to fostering a culture of dignity at work. Nossos colaboradores veem aqui a oportunidade de crescer e fazer história, seja por meio dos nossos recrutamentos internos, dos programas de desenvolvimento, treinamentos e do intercâmbio de conhecimento entre todas as nossas operações no Brasil. Acompanhar os planos de ações junto aos promotores e garantir o cumprimento da sistemática utilizando os indicadores de performance do time para garantir as metas e os resultados esperados, assegurando a efetividade da agenda de acordo com as estratégias recebidas da liderança. Garantir a gestão, distribuição e positivação dos materiais de merchandising (displays, materiais gráficos, brindes etc.) nos pontos de vendas, assegurando que os mesmos estejam sempre em bom estado e prontos para uso. Garantir que a equipe de promotores sob sua gestão tenha todos os EPIs necessários para executar uma rotina segura em loja, utilizando os equipamentos obrigatórios e orientando sobre o cumprimento das regras junto ao time de SSMA a fim de garantir a segurança do time. Conhecer e aplicar as práticas de consumo consciente e preservação dos recursos naturais, em conformidade com as políticas de SSMA da companhia, compreendendo os impactos e riscos ambientais, além de se familiarizar com os procedimentos de atendimento a emergências.
